localizedValues.name: S1-Kitchen Shelter
localizedValues.description:
Reservations for the S1-Kitchen Shelter are accepted up to nine months in advance of the start date by calling Twanoh State Park at 360-275-2222.
You can make reservations for dates that fall on Mondays through Thursdays during the May 15 - September 15 reservable period. The shelter cannot be reserved for Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays during the reservable period or other any dates outside of the reservable period.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
